battle.name: 隋擊吐谷渾之戰
battle.brief: 大業四年，隋煬帝楊廣親率百餘萬大軍西征青海，討伐吐谷渾王慕容伏允。前鋒宇文述等於蘭山遭遊牧騎兵夜襲而大敗，長矛與騎槊盡失其銳。此役未能滅國，卻耗盡府庫，成為日後三征高句麗與隋室覆亡的先聲。卡面亞述長矛，即冷兵器刺擊長兵的古典原型。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭的兩邊，是隋朝與吐谷渾。隋朝在西晉末以來羈縻鮮卑與北方部族建立的制度上重整北方，開皇年間在河西走廊與青海東緣設郡置縣、屯田儲糧，於是能在大業四年（608）一次徵發一百十三萬五千人，號稱百三十萬。指揮系統上，隋煬帝自任元帥，在長安、涿郡一帶設行台，河西方面的軍政歸尚書令宇文述節制，前鋒分二十餘路推進，禁軍各部、府兵與郡縣兵混編成軍，糧秣由隴右、關中及河西諸倉按軍次前送，軍令則由尚書省與行台書吏逐節傳遞。吐谷渾方面，是鮮卑慕容部西遷之後建立的遊牧政權，都城伏俟城在今青海海南州一帶，控弦之眾以數萬計，國中不設郡縣而以部落為單位，首領慕容伏允只需服眾部落首領即可，戰時以輕騎集合、掠食而後散歸牧地。兩國之間並無條約可循，實際界線是祁連山南北的草場與水源。吐谷渾同時與西突厥往來，一旦隋軍深入，草原上的部族隨時可能趁勢合流或趁虛叛離，這是隋廷無法單靠一場正面會戰解決的結構性難題。
countriesEn: This war was fought between the Sui dynasty and the Tuyuhun. The Sui had reorganised the northern frontier on the institutional legacy of the Xianbei and other steppe peoples, and during the Kaihuang era it had set up commanderies and counties in the Hexi Corridor and along the eastern edge of Qinghai, with military farms and stored grain; that is why in 608, in the fourth year of Daye, it could raise 1,135,000 men in a single levy, officially styled as 1.3 million. On the command side, Emperor Yang of Sui acted as his own supreme commander, with field headquarters established at Chang'an and Longyou; the military administration of the northwest was directed by the Director of the Department of State Affairs, Yuwen Shu, and the vanguard moved forward in more than twenty columns. Imperial guards, fubing levies and commandery troops were brigaded together, grain was forwarded to each echelon from the granaries of Longyou, Guanzhong and Hexi, and orders travelled step by step through the Secretariat and the field offices. The Tuyuhun was a nomadic polity founded by the Xianbei Murong clan after their westward migration; its capital of Fusi-cheng lay near today's Hainan Prefecture in Qinghai, and it could put several tens of thousands of men on the bow string. It had no commanderies or counties as the Chinese had, but was organised around tribes, and its ruler Murong Fuyun held authority only over so many as were willing to obey him; in war he simply gathered light horse, raided for supplies and dispersed back to the pastures. There was no treaty boundary between the two states: the real line ran through the grazing lands and watering places north and south of the Qilian Mountains. The Tuyuhun also maintained ties with the Western Turks, so that whenever a Sui army pushed deep into the plateau, steppe tribes might either close ranks with them or defect at the first sign of weakness, a structural problem that no single pitched battle could solve.
people: 隋煬帝楊廣是這場戰爭的發動者與最高指揮者。他在位初年把兵力與注意力同時投向高句麗、南方林邑與吐谷渾三個方向，此次西征意在一舉解決西線，使河西走廊與西域通道背後再無遊牧勢力。大業四年二月，隋朝最能謀劃的尚書左僕射高頍病逝，出師前夕即失去最熟悉西北形勢、曾力主經營涼州與討伐吐谷渾的統籌者，接著主持軍務的是尚書令宇文述與其子宇文化及；宇文述年長而失據，宇文化及少年驍勇而輕進，兩人率領前鋒深入青海，終致大敗。右武衛大將軍薛世雄是全軍唯一取得實質戰果者，他此前奉命經營鄯州，熟悉草原道路與馬政，此次統騎兵迂迴側翼，於亂軍之中取得戰果。御史大夫蘇威等在出師前進諫阻止遠征，未被採納，軍令仍出於一念。吐谷渾一側，慕容伏允善騎射，熟悉祁連山與青海湖之間每一處牧地與水源，他以拖延、夜襲與斷糧對抗隋軍的正面銳氣；他的太子慕容順日後成為降隋者，而殺死伏允的舍人祁威，要到戰局末段才出現。兩軍之中還有隨軍的鐵勒、契苾等內附部落首領充當嚮導與騎兵，漢人將校與胡騎混編，指令傳遞與協同作戰都極困難。
peopleEn: Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, was the initiator and the supreme commander of the campaign. Early in his reign he spread his troops and his attention simultaneously towards Goguryeo, the southern kingdom of Lin Yi and Tuyuhun; this western expedition was meant to settle the western front in a single stroke, so that the Hexi Corridor and the road to the Western Regions would no longer have a nomadic power at their back. In the second month of 608, Gao Jiong, the Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and the Sui's outstanding strategist, the man who had long argued for developing Liangzhou and for campaigns against the Tuyuhun, died of illness immediately before the army marched. Operational command then fell to the Director Yuwen Shu and to Yuwen Huaji, Shu's son: Shu was old and lacked confidence, Huaji was young, brave and impetuous, and the two led the vanguard deep into Qinghai, to eventual disaster. Xue Shixiong, Colonel of the Right Wuwei Guard, was the only commander to win anything of substance; he had already been stationed at Shanzhou, knew the grassland tracks and the horse system, and this time swung his cavalry round the flank to strike effectively amid the disorder. Su Wei, Censor-in-Chief, and others petitioned before the march to call the expedition off, and were not heard; the order went out on a single decision. On the Tuyuhun side, Murong Fuyun was a skilled horseman and archer who knew every pasture and every water source between the Qilian Mountains and Qinghai Lake; he met the Sui's frontal pressure with delay, night attacks and the cutting of supply lines. His heir, Murong Shun, would later surrender to the Sui, while Qiwei, the attendant who killed Fuyun, only appears at the very end of the story. On both sides, Xianbei and Qiefu clans who had submitted to the Sui served as guides and as cavalry; Chinese officers and steppe horsemen were brigaded together, which made the passing of orders and combined action extremely difficult.
kits: 卡面所列的亞述長矛，是兩河流域早期冷兵器刺擊長兵的古典原型：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，形制簡單，靠握持者的體力與隊形密度取勝。它在這場戰爭裡的角色，是標示「刺擊型長兵」這一類武器的源流，而不是描述隋軍的實際裝備。真正投入青海戰場的長兵器是隋軍的步槊與騎槊：步槊柄長過兩米，槍頭為刃，槍尾有鐏，由後排士卒在圓盾或小圓盾之後握持，結陣徐進，用以在亂軍中護住隊形核心；吐谷渾騎兵所用的矛較短，多為單手握持，方便在高速騎乘中完成突刺，必要時棄矛改用弓矢。弓矢仍是草原騎兵的主要武器，箭鏃以骨或鐵製成，射程短而射速快，衝鋒之前多以齊射之勢分批放箭，逼近時再收弓。防具方面，隋軍以披甲騎兵與大盾相配合，吐谷渾騎兵多不披重甲，靠鎧馬與馬具避免刀砍。攻城與輔助器械方面，隋軍帶有雲梯、撞車與擲石用的砲車，用於攻擊吐谷渾的城邑與山寨；唐古拉與祁連之間多為草場與石砌城堡，攻城器械消耗極快。運輸是這一役最吃緊的裝備：百餘萬人的糧秣、飲水與柴薪全靠車隊與駱駝輸送，隋軍雖備車輜輓重逾倍，仍遠不足以跟上急行軍的騎兵，最後把整支大軍拖垮。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a classical ancestor of the cold-weapon thrusting pole from the early riverine world: a short shaft, a long blade, an iron socketed head, a simple design that won by the wielder's strength and by the density of the formation. Its role in this war is to mark the lineage of the thrusting long weapon, not to describe what the Sui actually carried. The long arms that really fought on the Qinghai plateau were the Sui's foot spears and riding spears. The foot spear had a shaft more than two metres long with a bladed head and a butt spike, carried by the men of the rear rank behind the round or small round shield, closing slowly in order so as to hold the core of the formation together in the melee. The Tuyuhun horsemen used shorter spears, generally one-handed, so that the thrust could be delivered at speed while the rider kept control of the rein, and the spear was dropped for the bow whenever that was needed. The bow remained the grassland cavalry's principal weapon, with bone or iron arrowheads, short range but a fast rate of fire, loosed in successive volleys before the charge and gathered up as the riders closed. In armour the Sui matched plated cavalry with large shields, while the Tuyuhun riders generally fought without heavy armour, relying on barded horses and horse furniture to keep clear of cutting blows. For siege work and support the Sui brought scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwing trebuchets against the Tuyuhun's strongholds and hill forts; between the Tangla and Qilian ranges such places were built of stone, and siege equipment was consumed very quickly. Transport was the tightest constraint of the whole campaign: the grain, the water and the fuel of more than a million men had all to travel in wagon trains and on camels. The Sui brought more than double the wagons and baggage beasts it needed and still could not keep pace with the fast-moving horse, and in the end it was the baggage train that dragged the entire army down.
tactics: 隋軍的戰術是典型的大軍壓境配合分路滲透。宇文述、宇文化及等率精騎為前鋒，自張掖、鄯州一線分道南下，前鋒與主力之間的距離隨行程拉開到數百里，糧隊更落在後方更遠的位置；隋煬帝的中軍經大斗坂、焉支山南下，隊伍前後綿延數十里，旗幟與甲仗蔽空，聲勢極盛而節奏極慢。吐谷渾則完全放棄正面會戰，慕容伏允把主力分散在山谷與草場邊緣，專盯隋軍的先鋒營與糧隊；蘭山之戰即在此背景下發生，隋軍前鋒扎營夜裡遭遊牧騎兵突襲，營中無火無柵，枕戈待旦的兵員尚未上馬即被衝散，宇文述等只帶數百騎退回。隋軍隨後在星宿川一線窮追，設營駐紮、斷水斷草，試圖以圍困逼伏允現身；此舉反而拉長了補給線。撤退時隊伍混雜，後衛與輜重互相擁擠，又遭吐谷渾騎兵尾隨襲擊，損失更重。整役的教訓很清楚：以數十萬步兵扛著整個戰區的糧秣去追幾萬游牧騎兵，節奏必定被拖垮；薛世雄以二千騎奇襲得手，反而說明少量快速騎兵才是對草原敵軍有效的手段。
tacticsEn: The Sui plan was classic mass pressure combined with infiltration by separate columns. Yuwen Shu, Yuwen Huaji and the rest took light horse as vanguard and moved south in divided lines from Zhangye and Shanzhou; the distance between the vanguard and the main body grew to several hundred li as the march went on, and the baggage train fell further behind still. The emperor's central force came south by way of Dadou Ban and Yanzhi Mountain, the column stretching for tens of li front to back, banners and armour filling the sky, overwhelming in appearance and hopeless in pace. The Tuyuhun abandoned pitched battle altogether. Murong Fuyun dispersed his main body along the valleys and the edges of the pastures, and fixed his attention on the Sui's forward camps and supply columns. That was the setting of the battle of Lanshan, where a Sui forward camp was surprised at night by nomadic cavalry: the camp had no fires and no palisade, the soldiers who lay with their armour on were scarcely able to mount before the line was scattered, and Yuwen Shu and the others rode back with only a few hundred men. The Sui then pushed on to the Xingsuchuan line, dug in, and cut the water and the grass in the hope of forcing Fuyun to show himself, and the manoeuvre only lengthened the supply line. On the withdrawal the column was mixed and crowded, the rear guard and the baggage train jammed one another, and Tuyuhun riders followed them in, adding to the losses. The lesson of the whole campaign is clear: carrying the food of an entire theatre on the backs of several hundred thousand foot soldiers, in pursuit of a few tens of thousands of nomadic horsemen, must slow the army to a crawl. Xue Shixiong's success with two thousand cavalry in a surprise attack showed that small, fast, mobile horse was the only thing that really worked against a steppe enemy.
data: 關於兵員與行程，史料有較明確的數字：《資治通鑑》記大業四年隋軍出師兵一百十三萬五千人，號稱百三十萬，輜重車隊據稱又倍之；所徵發的役夫與物力總量，遠超過開皇之末任何一次用兵。行軍距離上，自長安經武威、張掖、鄯州至青海湖一線，行程約二千餘里，正軍尚可支持，前鋒與糧隊之間的距離卻常在數百里之外。薛世雄此前以二千騎奇襲鄯州得手，斬獲甚眾、奪馬以萬計，是全役中最有成效的一次打擊。蘭山之敗，隋軍前鋒死者相枕，宇文述等僅以數百騎逃回，具體傷亡數目史無明載，只能說損失極重。遠征進入高原後，軍中乏食、飲水不足，士卒飢病死者與凍死者眾，數字亦無記載，兵馬因飢餓與疾病減員的比例遠高於戰鬥本身。時間上，自七月出師到冬季班師，前後約三四個月；全軍雖推進至星宿川一帶，仍未能迫使慕容伏允決戰。吐谷渾一方的常備精騎為數萬之眾，部眾總數更多，因以部落分散牧居，隋軍無法計算其損失，史料也未留下雙方總兵力對照的數字。
dataEn: On numbers, the sources are fairly clear. The Zizhi Tongjian records that the expedition of 608 marched with 1,135,000 men, styled as 1.3 million, with the wagon and baggage train said to be larger again; the total of labour and supplies drawn up was heavier than for any other campaign at the end of the Kaihuang era. As for distance, the route ran from Chang'an through Wuwei, Zhangye and Shanzhou to the shores of Qinghai Lake, some two thousand li or more; the main body could just about be kept in hand, yet the gap between vanguard and baggage train was often several hundred li. Xue Shixiong's earlier surprise on Shanzhou with two thousand cavalry had cut the enemy up badly and taken horses by the tens of thousands, and it was the most effective blow of the campaign. After the defeat at Lanshan the Sui vanguard dead lay heaped together, and Yuwen Shu returned with only a few hundred riders; no exact casualty figure survives, and the loss can only be called very heavy. Once the expedition was up on the plateau, food was short, water was insufficient, and hunger, sickness and frost killed a great many; again no numbers are recorded, and the reduction of men and horses by want and disease far exceeded that of the fighting itself. In time, from the departure in the seventh month to the winter withdrawal, the campaign ran some three or four months. The army did push as far as the Xingsuchuan line, and still could not force Murong Fuyun to give battle. The Tuyuhun's regular light horse numbered several tens of thousands and their tribal population far more, but since they grazed in dispersed clans the Sui could not measure their losses, and the histories give no overall comparison of the two armies' strength.
cause: 戰爭的起因有三層。第一層是邊境衝突的累積：吐谷渾自西魏北周以來就趁隋邊軍更替反覆劫掠涼州、敦煌、張掖一帶，奪走牲畜、破壞城戍、威脅商道，隋文帝開皇年間曾遣軍討伐，一度迫使其稱臣，卻因吐谷渾居地草場分散、聚散無常，未能根除；慕容伏允即位後，掠邊的規模與頻率明顯上升。第二層是隋煬帝的即位與整體戰略：他既要壓服高句麗，又要打通西域通道，於是把河西線的安定視為前提，決定先滅吐谷渾，斷其與西突厥往來之路，再用兵東向。第三層是能力與條件：大業四年河西已屯田近二十年，倉儲與馬政足以支撐一次大規模遠征，鐵勒、契苾等內附部族熟悉草原並願意引路，隋廷自認有必勝把握。這說明此役不是被迫防守，而是主動的擴張選擇，風險由隋朝自己承擔。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The first was the accumulation of frontier conflict. Since the days of Western Wei and Northern Zhou the Tuyuhun had seized every change of watch in the Sui border by raiding Liangzhou, Dunhuang and Zhangye again and again, taking away livestock, breaking the forts and choking the caravan roads. The Sui had campaigned against them under Emperor Wen and forced a temporary submission, but because the Tuyuhun's pastures were scattered and their clans gathered and dispersed at will the trouble was never rooted out; under Murong Fuyun the scale and the frequency of the raids rose visibly. The second layer was the new emperor's overall strategy: he had to put down Goguryeo and open the road to the Western Regions, and so he treated the security of the western line as a precondition, decided to destroy the Tuyuhun first, cut their ties with the Western Turks, and only then turn his army eastward. The third layer was capacity and opportunity. After nearly twenty years of military farms the Hexi Corridor held granaries, horses and supplies enough to sustain a large expedition, and the submitted Xianbei and Qiefu clans knew the steppe and were willing to guide. The Sui court believed it had a sure thing. That is to say, this was not a war forced on the Sui in defence; it was a deliberate act of expansion, and the Sui carried the risk itself.
impact: 此役的影響，貫穿此後三年。第一，軍事上它沒有達成目標：百餘萬大軍的遠征沒有消滅吐谷渾，反而在蘭山與撤退途中損耗了大量兵馬與糧秣，隋朝的國力與民力都為此付出沉重代價；撤退之役造成的糧秣與牲畜損失，使隋廷在隨後兩年內難以同時支應青海與遼東兩個方向。第二，戰局後續的變化說明遠征雖然失敗，卻打散了吐谷渾的內部結構：大業五年（609）隋廷再遣軍入青海，築鄯州城於湟源、置西海郡，把勢力伸入草原；慕容伏允在隋軍反覆進逼下進退失據，大業六年（610）為自己舍人祁威所殺；大業七年（611）太子慕容順率眾降隋，吐谷渾政權覆亡，其眾分置於河西諸郡，隋朝自此直接控制青海湖流域，這條線此後再未回到遊牧政權手中，直到吐蕃興起。第三，戰略上，隋朝此後再未把主力放在對草原遊牧的正面會戰上，而改以經營鄯州、西海郡與屯田的方式控制邊疆，遠征與羈縻的分野由此定型。第四，這場戰役與同年西行途中焉支山高句麗使者引發的失禮交涉相糾纏，隋煬帝由此加深了對高句麗的敵意，隨後把大軍轉向遼東；三次征高句麗耗盡隋朝最後的儲備，隋亡的結局由此鋪開。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign run through the three years that followed. First, militarily it did not achieve its object. An expedition of more than a million men did not destroy the Tuyuhun, and instead lost a great many soldiers, horses and provisions at Lanshan and on the retreat, at heavy cost to the state's resources and to the people's labour; the losses in grain and draft animals made it impossible for the Sui to sustain two theatres, Qinghai in the west and Liaodong in the northeast, at the same time in the two years that followed. Second, the sequel shows that the expedition, though unsuccessful, broke the Tuyuhun's internal structure. In 609 the Sui sent troops into Qinghai again, built a walled Shanzhou at Huangyuan, created Xihai Commandery and pushed power into the grassland. Pressed repeatedly by Sui columns, Murong Fuyun found himself in a desperate position and was killed in 610 by his own attendant Qiwei; in 611 his heir Murong Shun led his people to surrender, the Tuyuhun state collapsed, its clans were settled into the commanderies of Hexi, and the Sui took direct control of the Qinghai Lake basin, a line that would not pass back into nomadic hands until the rise of Tubo. Third, strategically, the Sui never again committed its main strength to a pitched battle against steppe nomads; it switched to holding the frontier through Shanzhou, Xihai Commandery and military farms, and the division between expeditionary war and indirect rule was settled. Fourth, this campaign entangled with the incident on Yanzhi Mountain, where a Goguryeo envoy met the emperor during the same western journey; the affront fanned the emperor's hostility towards Goguryeo, and the mass of the army soon turned east. The three campaigns against Goguryeo drained the last of the Sui's reserves, and the dynasty's collapse was written from there.
result: 結果是隋軍的失敗與吐谷渾的暫時存續，並以另一種方式收場。大業四年秋，隋軍前鋒在蘭山遭突擊而崩潰，宇文述、宇文化及等以數百騎退回大營；隋煬帝震怒，收治敗將，有功者寥寥，絕大多數統兵之人都因敗績被貶或被誅，全軍士氣為之一挫。主力雖推進到星宿川一帶並一度切斷伏允的汲道，卻因糧秣斷絕、士卒飢凍而無法持久，終究在冬季撤軍，一路遭遊牧騎兵尾隨襲擊，損失更重，班師回京時已非出師之眾。吐谷渾則仍據青海湖與祁連山一帶，國力未損，繼續控制邊境水草與商道。此役之後的三年間，隋廷改弦更張，以重兵再入青海，先築鄯州、置西海郡，步步為營；大業六年（610）慕容伏允被舍人祁威所殺，大業七年（611）太子慕容順率眾降隋，吐谷渾國亡，其地併入隋朝版圖，餘眾分置河西諸郡安置，隋朝以郡縣與屯田取代了以部落為單位的統治方式。就兵器而言，這一役沒有任何一種長兵能左右勝負：亞述式短柄長刃的刺擊原型，與隋軍的步槊、吐谷渾的騎矛同屬刺擊技術一脈，卻抵擋不住饑寒與斷糧。真正決定戰局的，是補給、騎兵速度與指揮判斷，而隋朝恰恰在這三項上都出了問題。
resultEn: The outcome was a Sui defeat and the temporary survival of the Tuyuhun, which was closed in a different way. In the autumn of 608 the Sui vanguard was broken by a night attack at Lanshan, and Yuwen Shu, Yuwen Huaji and the rest rode back to the main camp with only a few hundred men. The emperor was furious: the defeated commanders were arrested and punished, honours were few, and most of the officers in the field were demoted or executed for the reverse, which took the heart out of the army. The main body did push as far as the Xingsuchuan line and at one point cut Fuyun off from his water, but a lack of food and the hunger and cold of the soldiers made the position untenable, and the army withdrew in winter, tailed by nomadic riders and losing still more on the march back; the host that returned to the capital was no longer the host that had marched out. The Tuyuhun still held the pastures of Qinghai Lake and the Qilian Mountains, was not materially weakened, and went on controlling the border water-grass and the caravan roads. In the three years after this campaign the Sui changed its method: it entered Qinghai again with weighty columns, first building Shanzhou and establishing Xihai Commandery, and advanced step by step. In 610 Murong Fuyun was killed by his own attendant Qiwei; in 611 the heir Murong Shun surrendered with his people; the Tuyuhun state perished and its territory passed into the Sui, the remaining clans being settled in the commanderies of Hexi, and commandery-and-farm administration replaced rule organised by tribes. As for arms, no single long weapon decided this war. The Assyrian-style short-shafted blade, the Sui foot spear and the Tuyuhun riding spear all belonged to one line of thrusting technique, yet none of them could hold against hunger, cold and broken supply. What actually settled the campaign was logistics, the speed of cavalry and the quality of command judgement, and in all three of those the Sui had made mistakes.
